summary: This clinical trial studies adults with schizophrenia spectrum disorders and obesity who have not responded well to a medication called metformin. Participants will receive either semaglutide or an inactive substance called a placebo to test how it affects weight change over time. The trial is sponsored by the Centre for Addiction and Mental Health and has an enrollment of 92 participants. The status of this trial is Active, not recruiting.
